title: Nested pullback square on a global restriction
statement: Let g:X→Y be a scheme map, W≤U opens of Y, T≤P opens of X, with P≤g⁻¹U and T≤g⁻¹W. Write rP and rT for the restricted maps, SX for exact restriction P→T, αY and αX for the canonical nested restriction comparisons, ξ for the fixed nested pullback square, and dP,dT for the pinned open pullback squares. For every M in D(Y), ξ.hom at the restriction of M to U, followed by LrT*(αY.hom at M) and dT.hom at M, equals SX(dP.hom at M) followed by αX.hom at Lg*M. No nonempty-open or boundedness condition is imposed.

proof.text: Use the inclusion pullback normalization to expand exact nested restriction and cancel the larger open immersion.
Expand the pinned open squares and move the inverse open comparison by naturality. Apply three instances of compositionTo_triangle for the named restricted composites, then cancel invertible factors.

lean.statement:
theorem perfectOverlapNestedPullbackSquare_on_image
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) {W U : Y.Opens} {T P : X.Opens}
    (iY : W ⟶ U) (iX : T ⟶ P)
    (hP : P ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U) (hT : T ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    (M : schemeDerivedCategory Y) :
    let rP := g.resLE U P hP
    let rT := g.resLE W T hT
    let ξ := perfectOverlapNestedPullbackSquare g iY iX hP hT
    let αY := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso Y iY
    let αX := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X iX
    let dP := singleComplexOpenPullbackSquareIso g U P rP
      (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι g hP)
    let dT := singleComplexOpenPullbackSquareIso g W T rT
      (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι g hT)
    ξ.hom.app ((schemeOpenRestriction Y U).mapDerivedCategory.obj M) ≫
        (derivedPullback rT).map (αY.hom.app M) ≫ dT.hom.app M =
      (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X iX).mapDerivedCategory.map (dP.hom.app M) ≫
        αX.hom.app ((derivedPullback g).obj M)
